name: dexless-rwa-infra
description: DEXless — Permissionless RWA Market Creation Layer on BNB Chain

scripts.deploy:mainnet: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.mainnet hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network bsc
scripts.verify:mainnet: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.mainnet hardhat run scripts/verify.ts --network bsc
scripts.flow:mainnet: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.mainnet hardhat run scripts/business-flow.ts --network bsc
scripts.rehearse: npm run wallets:fund && npm run deploy:testnet && npm run verify:testnet && npm run flow:testnet && npm run abi
scripts.app:build: npm run abi && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.wire:mainnet: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.mainnet hardhat run scripts/wire-live-feed.ts --network bsc
scripts.report:mainnet: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.mainnet hardhat run scripts/onchain-report.ts --network bsc
